original.verbatim:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you relocate your seat for the September 10th Yankees game. First, I need to verify your identity as a VIP season ticket holder.

I can see your ticket (TKT789012) is for Section 101 Row A in the Premium price tier for the MLB20250910YAN event. Before proceeding with seat relocation, I need to authenticate your account.

**Please provide:**
1. Your verification code (sent via email or SMS to your registered contact)

Once verified, I'll help you check available seating options in the Premium tier. Could you also let me know which specific section(s) you're interested in relocating to? This will help me check availability for you.

**Important notes:**
- Seat relocation is only permitted before gates open (VIP gates open 3 hours before first pitch at 4:00 PM EDT on Sept 10)
- You can only relocate within the same price tier (Premium)
- I'll need to check for available consecutive seats in your desired section

Please provide your verification code and preferred section(s) to continue.
